idea-plugin.name: IntelliJ Control Server
idea-plugin.description:
A lightweight IntelliJ IDEA plugin that exposes IDE capabilities via a local HTTP API.

✅ Available Now

  • Refactoring:
    • Rename Symbols: Rename variables, methods, classes, and parameters across your entire project with IntelliJ's powerful refactoring engine. Works with all languages supported by IntelliJ.
  • HTTP REST API: Local server (default port 8765) with comprehensive OpenAPI documentation
  • MCP Integration: Native Model Context Protocol support for AI assistants (Cursor, Claude Desktop)
  • Auto-start: Starts automatically when IntelliJ opens, with configurable settings
  • Health Monitoring: Real-time status endpoint to verify plugin connectivity

🚀 Coming Soon

  • More Refactorings: Move class, inline variable, change signature (v1.2+)
  • Navigation API: Jump to definitions, find usages, search symbols (v1.2+)
  • Tasks & Context: Manage IntelliJ tasks and editor contexts programmatically (v1.3+)

How it Works

The plugin runs a local HTTP server (default: http://localhost:8765) that accepts JSON requests. This enables external tools to control IntelliJ operations without manual intervention.

Installation & Setup

After installing the plugin and restarting IntelliJ, configure your AI assistant (e.g., Cursor) by adding this to your mcp.json file: 

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "intellij": {
      "command": "~/.intellij-mcp-bridge/bridge.sh"
    }
  }
}

The MCP bridge is automatically installed on first startup. No additional setup required!

Security

  • Binds to localhost only (127.0.0.1)
  • No authentication required (trusted local environment)
  • File access restricted to open project

For documentation and examples, visit the GitHub repository.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0 - Initial Release

  • HTTP Server: Local REST API (default port 8765)
  • Health Check: GET /health endpoint with uptime info
  • Swagger/OpenAPI: Interactive API documentation at /api-docs
  • Rename Refactoring: POST /{projectName}/refactor/rename - Line-based API for renaming symbols
  • Settings UI: Configure port, auto-start, CORS, and logging
  • Type-Safe API: All endpoints return strongly-typed data classes
  • AI-Friendly: Designed for integration with AI coding tools like Cursor
